Found and fixed on the way: the durable export job verified the approved mix/master revision but never passed its controls into the render, so the exported master used the arrangement's default mix, not the mix the user auditioned and approved (levels, pans, PR-25 automation). The `sources` steps in each report now name the revision's 15 automation segments and which targets won.

Rule made explicit: the approved revision decides the mix; the delivery profile decides the master targets; with no profile asked for, the revision's own targets stand so the export sounds like its audition.
KARAOKE / BACKING_TRACK exclusions were not exercised live: this arrangement has no voice or LEAD-role track; unit-tested.
Every LUFS figure here is BS.1770-4 gated loudness measured on the output, cross-checked against pyloudnorm; before PR-26 the code reported plain RMS dBFS as 'LUFS'.
